name: Gasthof und Hotel "Zur Post"
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn & Hotel "Zur Post" in Wallgau**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality at **Gasthof und Hotel "Zur Post"** in the charming village of **Wallgau**, nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy retreat offers warm rooms, traditional Tyrolean cuisine, and a welcoming atmosphere.

Indulge in hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and **Tyrolean dumplings** while enjoying panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, **Wallgau** is your perfect base for hiking, skiing, or simply unwinding in the alpine air.

Experience the warmth of Tyrol at **"Zur Post"**—where every stay feels like coming home.
